about: Behaviour recall (T10, 1.42.0): each scenario is a task in a seeded probe folder; scripts/recall-behave.mjs grades what the session did (tool calls, in order, with arguments), never its wording. A change to a scenario or a check is a new version, kept beside the old as the wording keys are. Each scenario maps to the wording key of the same number (recall-questions.md v12). Pass is the median of passed scenarios a run must reach. v2 (K134, build 17): scenario 5 passed a session that only never edited the page, and 10 any reply holding the word sweep; each now needs the behaviour itself (5: its prompt no longer tells the session to pick, which the owner's own words would allow; an ask for the owner's pick, by pop-up or in words, and no edit at all before it; 10: the sweep skill started or read, and no PR command). The build 17 sweep: 5 also refuses a page written by a shell command and needs a question about the layout, not any question mark; the PR and merge checks of 5, 10, 12 and 14 read gh.exe, gh -R and gh api too. Scenario 5 grades the ask only: whether the owner is shown a rendered wireframe, as key 5 also asks, is left to the wording key. 10 sees the skill started, not the reviewers it runs: a probe has no hosted remote. The v1 checks of 5 and 10 are kept under previous as a record of what v1 graded; no script runs them.
